description: Figure: GPS cleavage-motif PSSM scores across human adhesion GPCRs, motif alignment, and ADGRA2 ortholog +1 residue by vertebrate clade
code:
import requests, pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, json
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
H={"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"}
AA="ACDEFGHIKLMNPQRSTVWY"
BG=dict(zip(AA,[0.0826,0.0137,0.0546,0.0674,0.0387,0.0708,0.0227,0.0593,0.0582,0.0966,
                0.0242,0.0406,0.0472,0.0393,0.0553,0.0660,0.0535,0.0687,0.0109,0.0292]))
LO,HI=-8,8
GENES=["ADGRA1","ADGRA2","ADGRA3","ADGRB1","ADGRB2","ADGRB3","CELSR1","CELSR2","CELSR3",
 "ADGRD1","ADGRD2","ADGRE1","ADGRE2","ADGRE3","ADGRE5","ADGRF1","ADGRF2","ADGRF3","ADGRF4",
 "ADGRF5","ADGRG1","ADGRG2","ADGRG3","ADGRG4","ADGRG5","ADGRG6","ADGRG7","ADGRL1","ADGRL2",
 "ADGRL3","ADGRL4","ADGRV1"]
info={}
for g in GENES:
    url=("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search?query=gene_exact:%s+AND+organism_id:9606+AND+reviewed:true"
         "&fields=accession,sequence,ft_chain,ft_domain,ft_region&format=json&size=3")%g
    res=requests.get(url,headers=H,timeout=90).json().get("results",[])
    if not res: continue
    j=res[0]; seq=j["sequence"]["value"]; chains=[];gain=None;gps=None
    for f in j.get("features",[]):
        s=f["location"]["start"]["value"];e=f["location"]["end"]["value"];d=str(f.get("description",""))
        if f["type"]=="Chain": chains.append((s,e))
        if f["type"]=="Domain" and "GAIN" in d.upper(): gain=(s,e)
        if f["type"] in ("Region","Domain") and d.strip().upper().startswith("GPS"): gps=(s,e)
    site=None
    if gps:
        for (s,e) in chains:
            if gps[0]-5<=e<=gps[1]+5 and e<len(seq)-50: site=e
    info[g]=dict(acc=j["primaryAccession"],seq=seq,gain=gain,site=site)
wins={g:v['seq'][v['site']+LO:v['site']+HI] for g,v in info.items() if v['site']}
W=pd.DataFrame({g:list(w) for g,w in wins.items()}).T
W.columns=[p for p in range(LO,0)]+[p for p in range(1,HI+1)]
N=len(W); pssm={}
for p in W.columns:
    col=W[p].tolist(); counts={a:col.count(a)+2.0*BG[a]*np.sqrt(N) for a in AA}; tot=sum(counts.values())
    pssm[p]={a: float(np.log2((counts[a]/tot)/BG[a])) for a in AA}
POS=list(W.columns)
def sw_(w): return sum(pssm[p].get(a,-6.0) for p,a in zip(POS,w)) if len(w)==len(POS) else -99.0
def best_site(seq,lo,hi):
    b=(-1e9,None,"")
    for i in range(max(lo,-LO),min(hi,len(seq)-HI)):
        w=seq[i+LO:i+HI]; s=sw_(w)
        if s>b[0]: b=(s,i,w)
    return b
rows=[]
for g,v in info.items():
    if not isinstance(v['gain'],tuple): continue
    s,i,w=best_site(v['seq'],v['gain'][0]-1,v['gain'][1]+25)
    rows.append(dict(gene=g,acc=v['acc'],score=s,site=i,window=w,m6=w[2],m4=w[4],m2=w[6],m1=w[7],
                     p1=w[8],p3=w[10],curated=v['site'] is not None,
                     match=(v['site']==i) if v['site'] else None))
T=pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values("score",ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)
null=[]
for g,v in info.items():
    if not isinstance(v['gain'],tuple): continue
    for i in range(v['gain'][0]+8,v['gain'][1]-8): null.append(sw_(v['seq'][i+LO:i+HI]))
null=np.array(null)

# ortholog +1 by clade
q=info["ADGRA2"]['seq'][729:765]
def bm(seq,q):
    bs=-1;bi=None
    for i in range(0,len(seq)-len(q)+1):
        s=sum(1 for x,y in zip(seq[i:i+len(q)],q) if x==y)
        if s>bs: bs=s;bi=i
    return bs,bi
orows=[]
for tax,label in [(40674,"Mammalia"),(8782,"Aves"),(8504,"Lepidosauria"),(8459,"Testudines")]:
    url=("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search?query=gene:ADGRA2+AND+taxonomy_id:%d+AND+length:[1000+TO+1600]"
         "&fields=accession,organism_name,sequence&format=json&size=150")%tax
    for o in requests.get(url,headers=H,timeout=120).json().get("results",[]):
        seq=o["sequence"]["value"]; bs,bi=bm(seq,q)
        if bs<0.45*len(q): continue
        st=bi+17; w=seq[st+LO:st+HI]
        if len(w)!=16: continue
        orows.append(dict(clade=label,organism=o["organism"]["scientificName"],acc=o["primaryAccession"],
                          m2=w[6],m1=w[7],p1=w[8],window=w,score=sw_(w)))
O=pd.DataFrame(orows).drop_duplicates(["clade","organism"])

# ================= FIGURE =================
fig=plt.figure(figsize=(16,11))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(2,2,height_ratios=[1,1],hspace=0.45,wspace=0.25)

# A: PSSM score ranking
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,:])
cols=["#2a6f97" if c else "#b0b7bd" for c in T.curated]
for k,g in enumerate(T.gene):
    if g=="ADGRA2": cols[k]="#c1121f"
    if g=="ADGRA3": cols[k]="#e8871a"
ax.bar(range(len(T)),T.score,color=cols)
ax.axhline(np.percentile(null,99),ls="--",c="k",lw=1)
ax.text(len(T)-0.5,np.percentile(null,99)+1.2,"99th percentile of all in-GAIN windows",ha="right",fontsize=9)
ax.set_xticks(range(len(T))); ax.set_xticklabels(T.gene,rotation=90,fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel("GPS cleavage-motif PSSM score (bits)")
ax.set_title("A. Best-scoring GPS window in each human adhesion GPCR GAIN-B domain\n"
             "PSSM trained on 11 UniProt-curated cleavage sites; it recovers 11/11 curated sites exactly",
             loc="left",fontsize=11)
for k,g in enumerate(T.gene):
    if g in ("ADGRA2","ADGRA3"):
        ax.annotate(f"{g}\n{T.window[k][:8]}|{T.window[k][8:]}",(k,T.score[k]),xytext=(k,T.score[k]+9),
                    ha="center",fontsize=8.5,arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->",lw=0.8))
ax.legend(handles=[mpatches.Patch(color="#2a6f97",label="curated NTF/CTF chains in UniProt (cleaved)"),
                   mpatches.Patch(color="#b0b7bd",label="no curated chains"),
                   mpatches.Patch(color="#c1121f",label="ADGRA2"),
                   mpatches.Patch(color="#e8871a",label="ADGRA3")],fontsize=9,loc="upper right")
ax.set_ylim(0,60)

# B: motif alignment text panel
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,0]); ax.axis("off")
order=list(wins.keys())
y=1.0
ax.text(0.0,y,"B. GPS motif alignment, scissile bond between -1 and +1",fontsize=11,weight="bold"); y-=0.075
ax.text(0.02,y,"             -8      -1 | +1      +8",family="monospace",fontsize=10); y-=0.055
for g in order:
    w=wins[g]
    ax.text(0.02,y,f"{g:8s}  {w[:8]} | {w[8:]}",family="monospace",fontsize=10,color="#2a6f97"); y-=0.052
ax.text(0.02,y,"-"*44,family="monospace",fontsize=10); y-=0.052
for g,c in [("ADGRL1","#444"),("ADGRB3","#444"),("ADGRA3","#e8871a"),("ADGRA2","#c1121f")]:
    r=T[T.gene==g].iloc[0]; w=r.window
    ax.text(0.02,y,f"{g:8s}  {w[:8]} | {w[8:]}",family="monospace",fontsize=10,color=c,
            weight="bold" if g=="ADGRA2" else "normal"); y-=0.052
ax.text(0.02,y-0.02,"consensus  . . C . C . H L | T/S . F A V L M .",family="monospace",fontsize=10,weight="bold")
ax.text(0.02,y-0.09,"ADGRA2 keeps H(-2) and L(-1) but has Gly at +1 where all 11\ncleaved receptors have Thr or Ser, and lacks the invariant Cys at -6.",
        fontsize=9.5,color="#c1121f")

# C: ortholog +1 composition by clade
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,1])
ct=pd.crosstab(O.clade,O.p1)
ct=ct.reindex(["Mammalia","Aves","Lepidosauria","Testudines"]).fillna(0)
pal={"G":"#c1121f","S":"#2a6f97","N":"#8d99ae","R":"#edc531"}
bottom=np.zeros(len(ct))
for aa in ct.columns:
    ax.barh(range(len(ct)),ct[aa],left=bottom,color=pal.get(aa,"#ccc"),label=f"+1 = {aa}")
    bottom+=ct[aa].values
ax.set_yticks(range(len(ct))); ax.set_yticklabels([f"{c}\n(n={int(ct.loc[c].sum())})" for c in ct.index],fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlabel("number of ADGRA2 orthologs")
ax.set_title("C. Residue at the +1 position of the ADGRA2 GPS\nacross vertebrate orthologs",loc="left",fontsize=11)
ax.legend(fontsize=9)
plt.show()

print("Human aGPCR GPS table (provenance):")
print(T[["gene","acc","score","site","window","m6","m4","m2","m1","p1","p3","curated","match"]].round(2).to_string(index=False))
print("\nOrtholog +1 composition by clade:"); print(ct.astype(int).to_string())
print("\nADGRA2 rank: %d of %d GAIN-containing human aGPCRs (1 = most cleavage-like)"%(int(T[T.gene=='ADGRA2'].index[0])+1,len(T)))
print("Mean PSSM score of 11 curated cleaved: %.2f (sd %.2f); ADGRA2: %.2f"%(
    T[T.curated].score.mean(),T[T.curated].score.std(),T[T.gene=='ADGRA2'].score.iloc[0]))
print("Z of ADGRA2 vs curated-cleaved distribution: %.2f"%((T[T.gene=='ADGRA2'].score.iloc[0]-T[T.curated].score.mean())/T[T.curated].score.std()))
